map.5 天训练循环计划与打卡 使用指南: 5-Day Training Cycle Plan and Check-In User Guide
map.操作：点「添加课程」输入名称「力量训练」、教练「张教练」、每周频次 2 次；课表:
Operation: click "Add course" and enter the name "Strength Training", coach "Coach Zhang" and 2 sessions per week; the schedule auto-generates matching colour blocks on the calendar.
Check-in: click "Done" on that course's cell on a given day → the stats card "this week" +1 and total check-ins +1, progress…
map.规划一周训练课表（如力量、有氧、拉伸分在不同星期），用日历视图排布并着色区分。: Plan a weekly training schedule (strength, cardio, stretching on different days) laid out in a colour-coded calendar view.
map.每次练完在对应日期打卡，自动统计本周完成/总时段数与累计打卡数，量化坚持度。: After each session, check in on the matching date; the tool tallies sessions completed this week against total slots plus cumulative check-ins, quantifying consistency.
map.多课程并行管理（不同教练/不同项目），用色块与标签区分，避免冲突。: Manage multiple courses in parallel (different coaches / different activities) with colour blocks and labels to avoid conflicts.
map.使用演示：添加「力量训练」并打卡: Usage demo: add "Strength Training" and check in
map.课程与打卡记录保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，换设备/清缓存会丢失；: Course and check-in records are stored in the browser's localStorage; changing devices or clearing the cache loses them, so screenshot or back up important plans. This tool never connects to the network.
